claim.en: A golden cross (50-day MA crossing above the 200-day) is bullish; a death cross is bearish.
claim.zh: 50日线上穿200日线叫金叉，之后要涨；下穿叫死叉，之后要跌。

whoSaysIt.en: Chart-pattern staple on CNBC and Investopedia, repeated every time the S&P 500 prints a cross.
whoSaysIt.zh: 财经媒体和股评博主每逢指数出现金叉、死叉都会拿出来讲，是技术分析入门必学的信号。

howTested.en: We hold the market from the day after the 50-day average closes above the 200-day average (golden state) and stay out from the day after it closes below (death state). The claim says the golden state is bullish, so the test asks whether days spent in the golden state earned more than days spent outside it (difference of means, Welch t-stat), and whether that holds in both halves of each market's history. Separately we look at the 63-trading-day return after each cross itself.
howTested.zh: 50日均线收盘站上200日均线的次日起持有（金叉状态），跌破的次日起空仓（死叉状态）。说法是“金叉要涨”，所以检验的是：处在金叉状态的日子，平均收益是否高于其余日子（均值差，Welch t 值），并且在每个市场历史的前后两半都成立。另外单独看每次交叉之后 63 个交易日的收益。

caveat.en: Crosses are rare (a handful per market) so event-study results rest on very few independent observations.
caveat.zh: 每个市场十几年只有寥寥几次交叉，样本太少，统计上很难下结论。

claim.en: Only be invested when price is above the 200-day moving average.
claim.zh: 价格在200日均线上方才持有，跌破就离场。

whoSaysIt.en: Mebane Faber's 2007 'A Quantitative Approach to Tactical Asset Allocation' and Paul Tudor Jones's '200-day MA' remark made it a mainstream rule.
whoSaysIt.zh: Faber的趋势择时论文和保罗·都铎·琼斯那句“我只看200日线”流传很广，国内常说“年线”是牛熊分界线。

howTested.en: Long from the day after the close is above its 200-day simple average, cash from the day after it closes below. Compared with buy-and-hold over the same dates. The rule counts as working only if it cuts the maximum drawdown by at least a quarter and also improves the Sharpe ratio, in the full history and in both halves.
howTested.zh: 收盘价高于200日简单均线的次日起持有，跌破的次日起空仓，与同期买入持有比较。只有同时做到“最大回撤至少缩小四分之一”和“夏普比率更高”，并且在全样本和前后两半都成立，才算有效。

caveat.en: Test is on one price path per market; the rule's edge is mostly drawdown avoidance, which depends on a few crash episodes.
caveat.zh: 这是单一历史路径的结果，回撤优势主要来自2020、2022等少数几次大跌。

en: is 200 day moving average worth it

short.en: Sell in May and go away

claim.en: Sell in May and go away: stocks do better from November to April than May to October.
claim.zh: 五月卖出，躲过夏天（“五穷六绝七翻身”）：股市5月到10月不如11月到4月。

whoSaysIt.en: Old London stock-market adage, 'Halloween indicator' popularised by Bouman and Jacobsen (2002).
whoSaysIt.zh: 源自英国股市老谚语；A股圈有“五穷六绝七翻身”的类似说法，美股博主每年四月底都会重提。

howTested.en: Month-end to month-end returns for the S&P 500 (SPY). Summer months (May to October) are compared with winter months (November to April) with a difference-of-means t-test, and the sign must be the same in both halves of the history. The claim holds only if summer is lower than winter and the gap passes the significance guard.
howTested.zh: 用标普 500（SPY）的月度收益（月末到月末）。把夏季（5月至10月）和冬季（11月至4月）做均值差 t 检验，并且前后两半历史方向一致。只有夏季明显低于冬季、且通过显著性检查，说法才成立。

caveat.en: About 15 years of data gives only about 15 observations per market.
caveat.zh: 只有十五年左右的数据，每个市场也就十几个样本，容易被个别年份左右。

en: sell in may and go away
sell in may does it work

label.en: Other markets (context, not part of the verdict)
label.zh: 其他市场（仅供参考，不计入结论）

claim.en: Stocks rally in the last five trading days of December and the first two of January.
claim.zh: 圣诞行情：年底最后五个交易日加新年头两天，股市往往上涨。

whoSaysIt.en: Yale Hirsch coined it in the Stock Trader's Almanac (1972).
whoSaysIt.zh: 《股票交易者年鉴》耶鲁·赫希提出，每年12月财经媒体都会引用。

howTested.en: The window is the last five trading days of December plus the first two of January. We compare the average daily return inside the window with all other days (Welch t-stat) and list the window return and hit rate for every year.
howTested.zh: 窗口是12月最后五个交易日加1月头两个交易日。比较窗口内的日均收益与其余日子（Welch t 值），并列出每一年窗口的收益和上涨年份占比。

caveat.en: A seven-day window per year yields roughly 15 data points; any apparent edge is hard to separate from luck.
caveat.zh: 每年只有一个七天窗口，十五年才十五个样本，很难和运气区分。

label.en: Other markets (context, not part of the verdict)
label.zh: 其他市场（仅供参考，不计入结论）

claim.en: January is the best month for stocks.
claim.zh: 一月是全年表现最好的月份。

whoSaysIt.en: Sidney Wachtel (1942) documented small-cap January strength; 'As January goes, so goes the year' from Stock Trader's Almanac.
whoSaysIt.zh: “一月效应”和“一月晴雨表”是年鉴派老话，国内常听“开门红”。

howTested.en: Month-end to month-end returns for SPY. January is compared with the other eleven months (Welch t-stat), must rank in the top three of the twelve calendar months by average return, and must be positive in both halves of the history.
howTested.zh: 用SPY的月度收益（月末到月末）。把一月与其余十一个月比较（Welch t 值），要求一月的平均收益在十二个月里排前三，并且前后两半历史都成立。

caveat.en: The classic effect is a small-cap effect; we only have large-cap and broad ETFs.
caveat.zh: 经典一月效应主要出在小盘股，我们只有大盘和宽基ETF，不能完全代表。

label.en: Other markets (context, not part of the verdict)
label.zh: 其他市场（仅供参考，不计入结论）

claim.en: The best days for stocks are around the turn of the month.
claim.zh: 月底月初买入，换月效应。

whoSaysIt.en: Documented by Ariel (1987) and Lakonishok and Smidt (1988); popular with Quantpedia and r/algotrading.
whoSaysIt.zh: 月末发工资、资金入场的说法，量化论坛常提。

howTested.en: The window is the last trading day of a month plus the first three trading days of the next. We compare the average daily return inside the window with all other days (Welch t-stat), in the full history and in both halves.
howTested.zh: 窗口是每月最后一个交易日加下个月头三个交易日。比较窗口内的日均收益与其余日子（Welch t 值），并看全样本和前后两半是否一致。

caveat.en: Without flow or cash-timing data we cannot tell why it works or whether it survives costs.
caveat.zh: 没有资金流数据，只能看现象，看不出原因，也没扣交易成本。

en: best days of month stock market

label.en: Other markets (context, not part of the verdict)
label.zh: 其他市场（仅供参考，不计入结论）

claim.en: Buy when RSI drops below 30 (oversold), sell when it rises above 70 (overbought).
claim.zh: RSI低于30超卖买入，高于70超买卖出。

whoSaysIt.en: J. Welles Wilder Jr., 'New Concepts in Technical Trading Systems' (1978); the most-quoted indicator rule on YouTube and Reddit.
whoSaysIt.zh: Wilder在1978年提出，雪球、知乎上最常见的“超买超卖”信号。

howTested.en: Wilder RSI(14) of the close. Event: the close at which RSI is below 30. We record the 10-trading-day return that follows (events at least 10 days apart) and compare it with the average 10-day return over all days of the same market. The sell half is checked the same way: returns after RSI above 70 should be lower than average. A full buy-under-30, sell-over-70 rule (maximum 20 days held) is shown as a cross-check.
howTested.zh: 收盘价的 Wilder RSI(14)。事件：RSI 低于30的收盘日。记录之后10个交易日的收益（事件间隔至少10天），和该市场所有日子的10日平均收益比较。卖出一半用同样方法检验：RSI 高于70之后的收益应当低于平均。另附完整的“30以下买入、70以上卖出”规则（最长持有20天）作交叉验证。

caveat.en: Works or fails differently in trending versus ranging markets; a single parameter set is not the whole story.
caveat.zh: 在趋势市和震荡市里表现差别很大，单一参数不代表整个指标。

label.en: The full rule: buy under 30, sell over 70 (or after 20 days)
label.zh: 完整规则：30以下买入，70以上卖出（或持有满20天）

claim.en: Buy the dip: after a down day or pullback, prices bounce.
claim.zh: 逢低买入：跌下来就是机会，抄底能赚钱。

whoSaysIt.en: Retail rallying cry on Reddit's WallStreetBets and everywhere in the 2010-2021 bull market.
whoSaysIt.zh: 散户圈的口头禅，“跌了就加仓”“回调就是上车机会”。

howTested.en: Event: the close is down 3% or more over five trading days while it is above its 200-day average (a dip inside an uptrend). We record the 21-trading-day return from that close (events at least 21 days apart) and compare it with the average 21-day return of the same market. The same fall below the 200-day average is shown for contrast and does not count towards the verdict.
howTested.zh: 事件：收盘价五个交易日累计下跌3%以上，且仍在200日均线上方（上升趋势里的回调）。记录该收盘之后21个交易日的收益（事件间隔至少21天），和同一市场的21日平均收益比较。200日均线下方的同样跌幅仅作对照，不计入结论。

caveat.en: Dips in a long bull market look good partly because the whole period was a bull market.
caveat.zh: 样本期正好是长牛，抄底成功有一部分是大环境的功劳。

label.en: 5-day fall of 3% or more, above the 200-day average
label.zh: 5日跌幅达3%以上，且在200日均线上方
同样的跌幅，但在200日均线下方

claim.en: The trend is your friend: buy what is going up, sell what is going down.
claim.zh: 趋势是你的朋友，顺势而为。

whoSaysIt.en: Wall Street proverb popularised by Ed Seykota and Jesse Livermore lore; the core pitch of trend-following CTAs.
whoSaysIt.zh: “顺势而为”“趋势为王”，海龟交易法和CTA圈的核心信念。

howTested.en: Time-series momentum: long from the day after the 252-day return is positive, cash otherwise. The claim counts as true if the Sharpe ratio beats buy-and-hold in the full history and in both halves. Shorter lookbacks are shown as a robustness check.
howTested.zh: 时间序列动量：过去252日收益为正的次日起持有，否则空仓。只要全样本以及前后两半的夏普比率都超过买入持有，就算说法成立。更短的回看周期作稳健性检查。

caveat.en: Profitable trend following depends heavily on a few big trends; this sample has only 10 markets.
caveat.zh: 趋势策略的利润集中在少数几波大行情，十个品种不够多。

claim.en: Cut your losses short and let your profits run: use a stop loss.
claim.zh: 截断亏损，让利润奔跑；做单一定要设止损。

whoSaysIt.en: David Ricardo's 19th-century rule, repeated by Jesse Livermore and every risk-management course.
whoSaysIt.zh: 投资格言，“止损是交易的生命线”，雪球和知乎教程里必提。

howTested.en: Hold the market; if the close falls 15% below the highest close since entry (a trailing stop, which is what 'let profits run' implies), go to cash; re-enter when the close exceeds its previous 50-day high. Compared with buy-and-hold. The stop counts as working only if it cuts the maximum drawdown by at least a quarter and also improves the Sharpe ratio, in the full history and in both halves. Tighter and looser trailing stops and a fixed stop 10% below the entry price are shown as robustness checks. Stops are tested on daily closes, so gaps are not modelled.
howTested.zh: 持有标的；收盘价比入场以来的最高收盘价低15%（移动止损，也就是“让利润奔跑”的做法）就转为空仓；收盘价突破前50日高点时重新入场。与买入持有比较。只有同时做到“最大回撤至少缩小四分之一”和“夏普比率更高”，并且全样本和前后两半都成立，才算止损有效。更紧和更松的移动止损，以及入场价下方10%的固定止损，作稳健性检查。止损按日收盘价测试，没有模拟跳空。

caveat.en: Daily closes ignore intraday gaps and slippage, so real stops would execute worse.
caveat.zh: 日线收盘价看不到盘中跳空和滑点，实际止损成交会更差。

en: trailing stop vs buy and hold

label.en: Fixed stop 10% below the entry price

claim.en: Bitcoin follows a four-year cycle around the halving: prices peak 12-18 months after each halving.
claim.zh: 比特币四年周期：减半后12到18个月见顶。

whoSaysIt.en: Crypto Twitter and YouTube analysts; PlanB's stock-to-flow narrative.
whoSaysIt.zh: 币圈最流行叙事，“减半行情”“四年一轮牛熊”。

howTested.en: Halving dates 2016-07-09, 2020-05-11 and 2024-04-20 (first close on or after each). For Bitcoin we record the return over the next 90, 180 and 365 days and the number of days from the halving to the highest close within the following 600 days, and compare the returns with the average for all days. With three events there is no statistical test to run; the page lists them for context.
howTested.zh: 减半日期为2016-07-09、2020-05-11、2024-04-20（取当天或之后的第一个收盘价）。记录比特币之后90、180、365天的收益，以及此后600天内最高收盘价距减半日的天数，并与所有日子的平均值比较。只有三个事件，做不了统计检验，列出来仅供参考。

caveat.en: Three halvings are three observations; any pattern is basically anecdote.
caveat.zh: 只有三次减半，等于三个样本，更多是故事而不是统计。

claim.en: Gold is a safe haven: it goes up when stocks crash.
claim.zh: 黄金是避险资产：股市大跌时，金价会涨。

whoSaysIt.en: Standard line from gold dealers and financial media during every sell-off.
whoSaysIt.zh: 金融媒体和黄金投资宣传的老话，“乱世买黄金”。

howTested.en: On the dates both SPY and GLD traded, we pick the days when SPY fell 2% or more and look at the same-day return of GLD, comparing its average with GLD's average on all days (t-stat on the event days). The worst 5% of SPY months are listed as a second look. The claim holds if gold is clearly higher than usual on those days, in both halves.
howTested.zh: 在SPY和GLD都有交易的日子里，挑出SPY单日下跌2%以上的那些天，看GLD当天的收益，并与GLD所有日子的平均收益比较（对事件日做 t 检验）。另外列出SPY最差的5%月份作第二个视角。只有黄金在这些日子里明显高于平常，并且前后两半都成立，说法才成立。

caveat.en: Gold has been positive over this period regardless; event windows may be partly luck.
caveat.zh: 样本期黄金整体涨得不错，避险窗口里的好表现未必只因为危机。

en: does gold go up when stocks crash

claim.en: When the VIX is high, it is time to buy (be greedy when others are fearful).
claim.zh: VIX高企是买入时机，别人恐惧我贪婪。

whoSaysIt.en: Common saying on fintwit; also Warren Buffett's 'be greedy when others are fearful'.
whoSaysIt.zh: “VIX飙升就是抄底信号”，雪球上常配巴菲特名言。

howTested.en: The VIX is not in our data, so we use 20-day realized volatility of each market as a stand-in (annualised). Event: it ranks in the top 10% of its own last five years (at least one year of history needed). We record the 63-trading-day return from that close (events at least 63 days apart) and compare it with the average 63-day return of the same market. This is realized, not implied, volatility.
howTested.zh: 我们的数据里没有VIX，用各市场自己的20日已实现波动率（年化）代替。事件：它处在自身近五年（至少要有一年历史）最高的10%。记录该收盘之后63个交易日的收益（事件间隔至少63天），与同一市场的63日平均收益比较。注意这是已实现波动率，不是期权隐含波动率。

caveat.en: Realized volatility is not implied volatility; the real VIX includes forward-looking option pricing.
caveat.zh: 已实现波动率不等于VIX，后者包含期权的前瞻性定价。

label.en: 20-day realized volatility in its top 10% of the last 5 years
label.zh: 20日已实现波动率处于近5年最高的10%

short.en: Time in the market beats timing

claim.en: Missing the best 10 days wrecks your returns, so time in the market beats timing the market.
claim.zh: 错过最好的10个交易日，收益就毁了，所以持有时间比择时重要。

whoSaysIt.en: Fund companies (JPMorgan, Fidelity) chart this in every retirement brochure.
whoSaysIt.zh: 基金公司定投宣传里常见图，“长期持有”“别预测市场”。

howTested.en: For each market with positive growth we replace the 10 best daily returns with zero (cash) and measure how much of the total log growth disappears; then the same for the 10 worst days, and for both. 'Wrecked' means at least a third of the total growth is lost, and in each half of the history the best 5 days must cost at least that share. We also count how many of the best days fall within 21 trading days of one of the worst days.
howTested.zh: 对每个长期上涨的市场，把涨幅最大的10个交易日的收益换成零（持有现金），看总对数增长损失了多少；再对跌得最狠的10天做同样处理，以及两者同时去掉。“毁掉”的标准是损失至少三分之一的总增长，并且前后两半历史里去掉最好的5天也要损失同样比例。另外统计有多少个最佳交易日与最差交易日相隔不到21个交易日。

caveat.en: The exercise is hypothetical (nobody can pick those days) and it also shows missing the worst days helps just as much.
caveat.zh: 该分析是后视镜视角，没人能提前挑出这些日子，而且避开最差的日子同样有效。

en: time in the market vs timing

short.zh: 涨时爬楼梯，跌时坐电梯

claim.en: Markets take the stairs up and the elevator down.
claim.zh: 涨时爬楼梯，跌时坐电梯：上涨慢、下跌快。

whoSaysIt.en: Wall Street saying often attributed to traders; cited in crash commentary.
whoSaysIt.zh: “阴跌”“暴跌”之类股评老话，涨得慢跌得快。

howTested.en: Skewness of daily returns: a negative value means the biggest moves are down moves (slow climbs, sudden drops). The t-stat of skewness is skew / sqrt(6 / n); it must be below -2 and negative in both halves. We also report the average down day and up day and the worst and best day. Only daily returns are tested, not the length of rallies and declines.
howTested.zh: 日收益的偏度：负值表示最大的波动是下跌（慢慢涨、突然跌）。偏度的 t 值为偏度 / sqrt(6 / n)，需要小于-2，并且前后两半都是负值。同时给出平均下跌日和上涨日的幅度，以及最差日和最好日。只检验日收益的分布，不检验上涨和下跌波段的时间长短。

caveat.en: Rally and drop legs depend on how turning points are defined.
caveat.zh: 涨跌波段的定义不同，结论会有差异。

en: markets fall faster than they rise

claim.en: Buy when MACD crosses above its signal line, sell when it crosses below.
claim.zh: MACD金叉买入，死叉卖出。

whoSaysIt.en: Gerald Appel's indicator (1979); the textbook example on Investopedia and TradingView.
whoSaysIt.zh: 最流行的技术指标之一，雪球、知乎和炒股软件教程都讲。

howTested.en: MACD line = 12-day EMA minus 26-day EMA of the close; signal line = 9-day EMA of the MACD. Long from the day after MACD is above its signal line, cash otherwise. The claim holds if the Sharpe ratio beats buy-and-hold in the full history and in both halves on most markets.
howTested.zh: MACD线 = 收盘价12日EMA减26日EMA；信号线 = MACD的9日EMA。MACD高于信号线的次日起持有，否则空仓。多数市场的夏普比率在全样本以及前后两半都超过买入持有，说法才成立。

caveat.en: Signals are numerous so costs matter; none are included here.
caveat.zh: 信号频繁，交易成本会吃掉很多收益，这里没有扣成本。

label.en: Only when MACD is above zero

claim.en: Price touching the lower Bollinger Band is a buy; upper band is a sell.
claim.zh: 股价触及布林带下轨买入，上轨卖出。

whoSaysIt.en: John Bollinger's bands (1980s); every retail trading tutorial.
whoSaysIt.zh: 炒股软件里的经典指标，“下轨抄底，上轨逃顶”。

howTested.en: Bands are the 20-day average plus and minus two sample standard deviations of the close. Event: the close is below the lower band. We record the 10-trading-day return that follows (events at least 10 days apart) and compare it with the market's average 10-day return. The upper-band half is checked the same way (returns should be lower than average).
howTested.zh: 布林带为收盘价20日均线上下各2个样本标准差。事件：收盘跌破下轨。记录之后10个交易日的收益（事件间隔至少10天），与该市场的10日平均收益比较。上轨一半用同样方法检验（之后的收益应低于平均）。

caveat.en: In strong trends price can ride the band for weeks, so averages mix very different regimes.
caveat.zh: 强趋势里价格会沿着上轨或下轨走很久，平均数把不同行情混在了一起。

label.en: Buy under the lower band, exit at the middle band or after 10 days
label.zh: 跌破下轨买入，回到中轨或持有10天后卖出

short.en: New highs lead to more highs

claim.en: Buying at new highs works: new highs lead to more new highs.
claim.zh: 创新高之后还会创新高，不要怕高位。

whoSaysIt.en: George and Hwang (2004) 52-week-high momentum; frequently quoted when indices make records.
whoSaysIt.zh: “突破新高是强势表现”“股价新高后涨势不止”，指数创新高时常被引用。

howTested.en: Event: the close is above every close of the previous 252 trading days. We record the 63-trading-day return from that close (events at least 63 days apart) and compare it with the average 63-day return of the same market.
howTested.zh: 事件：收盘价高于此前252个交易日的所有收盘价。记录该收盘之后63个交易日的收益（事件间隔至少63天），与同一市场的63日平均收益比较。

caveat.en: Overlapping signals cluster in bull markets, making observations non-independent.
caveat.zh: 新高信号集中出现在牛市，观测并不独立。

en: stocks at all time high future returns

label.en: Close above all closes of the previous 252 days
label.zh: 收盘价高于此前252日的所有收盘价

claim.en: Monday is the worst day of the week for stocks.
claim.zh: 周一是一周里表现最差的交易日。

whoSaysIt.en: Documented by Frank Cross (1973) and French (1980) 'weekend effect'.
whoSaysIt.zh: “周一综合征”“周五效应”，A股和美股都有人讲。

howTested.en: Daily close-to-close returns of SPY grouped by weekday. Monday is compared with all other days (Welch t-stat), must have the lowest average of the weekdays and a negative difference in both halves of the history. A Monday return covers the weekend, so it is the previous Friday close to Monday close.
howTested.zh: SPY的日收盘到收盘收益按星期几分组。把周一和其余各日比较（Welch t 值），要求周一是各个交易日里平均收益最低的，并且前后两半历史差值都为负。周一的收益是上周五收盘到周一收盘，包含了周末。

caveat.en: Close-to-close Monday return mixes weekend news with Monday trading, so cause is unclear.
caveat.zh: 周一收盘对比上周五收盘，包含周末消息和周一交易，无法区分。

en: best day of the week to buy stocks

label.en: Other markets (context, not part of the verdict)
label.zh: 其他市场（仅供参考，不计入结论）

short.en: Buy when there is blood in the streets

claim.en: Buy when there is blood in the streets: a 20% crash is the time to buy.
claim.zh: 血流成河时买入：大跌20%就是机会。

whoSaysIt.en: Attributed to Baron Rothschild; repeated by Warren Buffett fans and Reddit.
whoSaysIt.zh: 罗斯柴尔德名言，“别人恐惧我贪婪”，大跌后雪球上最常见的鸡汤。

howTested.en: Drawdown is the close divided by the highest close so far, minus one. Event: the first day it reaches -20% after having been above -10%. We record the 250-trading-day return from that close and compare it with the average 250-day return of the same market. Such events are rare, so a milder -10% version is shown for contrast.
howTested.zh: 回撤 = 收盘价 / 历史最高收盘价 - 1。事件：回撤此前一直小于10%，首次达到-20%的那一天。记录该收盘之后250个交易日的收益，与同一市场的250日平均收益比较。这类事件很少，所以另列一个较温和的-10%版本作对照。

caveat.en: A 20 percent drop can continue to 50 percent (2008, 2022 crypto); the average hides that.
caveat.zh: 跌20%之后还可能再跌30%，平均值会掩盖这种风险。

en: buy when there is blood in the streets

label.zh: 回撤达到-20%（此前回撤小于10%）
回撤达到-10%（此前回撤小于5%）

claim.en: Dollar-cost averaging beats investing a lump sum.
claim.zh: 定投比一次性买入更划算。

whoSaysIt.en: Vanguard's research says lump sum wins 2/3 of time; DCA is nonetheless an everyday recommendation.
whoSaysIt.zh: 定投神话：“微笑曲线”“越跌越买”，知乎雪球定投帖不断。

howTested.en: For every possible start date: a lump sum buys everything on day 0; dollar-cost averaging buys one twelfth on day 0 and then one twelfth every month for 11 more months, with the rest in cash at 0%. Both are valued twelve months after the start. We report the share of start dates on which DCA ends ahead, and the 5th-percentile outcome of each. Start dates overlap heavily, so they are not independent trials.
howTested.zh: 对每一个可能的起点：一次性买入在第0天全部买入；定投在第0天买入十二分之一，之后每月再买十二分之一，共12笔，未投入部分按零利率放现金。两者都在起点之后十二个月估值。统计定投最终领先的起点占比，以及两种方式第5百分位的结果。相邻起点高度重叠，不是独立样本。

caveat.en: Cash earns zero here, which flatters lump sum a little, and we ignore investor behaviour.
caveat.zh: 现金按零利率计，略偏向一次性投入，也没考虑人的心理承受力。

en: dollar cost averaging vs lump sum
zh: 定投 vs 一次性投入

claim.en: Bitcoin is digital gold: it holds up when stocks fall.
claim.zh: 比特币是数字黄金：股市下跌时它能顶住。

whoSaysIt.en: Michael Saylor, Grayscale and many crypto influencers.
whoSaysIt.zh: 币圈常说“数字黄金”，但近年越来越像科技股。

howTested.en: On the dates both SPY and Bitcoin have a close (weekdays), we pick the days when SPY fell 2% or more and look at the same-day return of Bitcoin against its average on all days. A safe haven has to be clearly higher than usual on those days, in both halves. Correlations with gold and with stocks are shown for context.
howTested.zh: 在SPY和比特币都有收盘价的日子（工作日）里，挑出SPY单日下跌2%以上的那些天，看比特币当天的收益并与其所有日子的平均比较。避险资产在这些日子里必须明显高于平常，并且前后两半都成立。另附比特币与黄金、与股票的相关系数作背景。

caveat.en: Correlation changes over time and says nothing about long-term store of value.
caveat.zh: 相关性随时间变化，也无法证明是否能长期保值。

label.en: Bitcoin vs gold: correlation of daily returns
label.zh: 比特币与黄金：日收益相关系数

label.en: Bitcoin vs the S&P 500: correlation of daily returns
label.zh: 比特币与标普500：日收益相关系数

claim.en: Buy last year's winners and sell last year's losers (12-1 momentum).
claim.zh: 买过去一年涨得最多的，卖掉跌得最多的（12-1动量）。

whoSaysIt.en: Jegadeesh and Titman (1993); AQR and quant Twitter promote it.
whoSaysIt.zh: 学术界的“动量效应”，国内量化圈也叫“强者恒强”。

howTested.en: We do not rebuild this test; we read the site's two momentum rotation strategies (cross-sectional momentum, asset-class rotation) and compare each with its benchmark over the last five years and over the full history. The claim holds only if the Sharpe ratio is higher in both windows. The benchmark is the S&P 500 buy-and-hold shown on the strategy pages, which is a tough yardstick for a ten-market rotation.
howTested.zh: 这条我们不重新搭建检验，而是读取本站两个动量轮动策略（截面动量、资产类别轮动）的回测结果，在近五年和全样本两个窗口里分别和基准比较。只有两个窗口的夏普比率都更高，说法才成立。基准是策略页上显示的标普500买入持有，对一个十市场的轮动策略来说是比较苛刻的参照。

caveat.en: Ten assets is a small universe, much smaller than the stock cross-sections used in academic work.
caveat.zh: 只有十个资产，远小于学术研究里的股票截面。

claim.en: Oil and stocks move together: oil falling means stocks fall.
claim.zh: 油价和股市同涨同跌，油价暴跌股市也跟着跌。

whoSaysIt.en: Media line since 2014-2016 and the 2020 oil crash.
whoSaysIt.zh: 2020年原油价格暴跌时财经媒体常讲“油股联动”。

howTested.en: Correlation of daily returns between the oil ETF USO and SPY on common dates, for the full history and each half, with a 126-day rolling line. A correlation of at least 0.30 in the right direction in all three periods counts as moving together; between 0.10 and 0.30 as a weak link.
howTested.zh: 原油ETF（USO）与SPY在共同交易日的日收益相关系数，看全样本和前后两半，并画出126日滚动相关。三个时期都达到0.30以上才算同涨同跌；0.10到0.30之间算联系较弱。

caveat.en: USO is a futures ETF with roll costs, so it differs from spot oil.
caveat.zh: USO是期货ETF，有展期损耗，和现货油价不同。

label.en: SPY on days when oil fell 3% or more
label.zh: 原油单日跌3%以上时的标普500

claim.en: September is the worst month of the year for stocks.
claim.zh: 九月是全年最差的月份。

whoSaysIt.en: Stock Trader's Almanac repeats it every August.
whoSaysIt.zh: 美股博主每年八月底都会提醒“九月魔咒”。

howTested.en: Month-end to month-end returns for SPY. September is compared with the other eleven months (Welch t-stat), must be among the two lowest of the twelve calendar months by average return, and negative relative to the rest in both halves of the history.
howTested.zh: 用SPY的月度收益（月末到月末）。把九月与其余十一个月比较（Welch t 值），要求九月的平均收益在十二个月里最低的两个之内，并且前后两半历史里九月都低于其余月份。

caveat.en: With ~15 Septembers, the ranking among 12 months is highly noisy.
caveat.zh: 十五个九月对十二个月排名，随机性很大。

en: why is september bad for stocks
zh: 九月是不是最差的月份

label.en: Other markets (context, not part of the verdict)
label.zh: 其他市场（仅供参考，不计入结论）

claim.en: Bitcoin pumps in October and Q4 ('Uptober').
claim.zh: 十月和第四季度是比特币的涨季（Uptober）。

whoSaysIt.en: Crypto Twitter meme; BTC's Octobers were mostly green.
whoSaysIt.zh: 币圈“十月红”“Q4行情”。

howTested.en: Month-end to month-end returns for Bitcoin and Ether. October is compared with the other eleven months (Welch t-stat), in the full history and in both halves; the whole fourth quarter is shown as a second look. Bitcoin has about a dozen Octobers and Ether fewer, so the significance guard is hard to pass.
howTested.zh: 比特币和以太坊的月度收益（月末到月末）。把十月与其余十一个月比较（Welch t 值），看全样本和前后两半；另外单独看整个第四季度。比特币只有十来个十月，以太坊更少，很难通过显著性检查。

caveat.en: About a dozen observations, with a strong dependence on bull-cycle timing.
caveat.zh: 只有十来个样本，且深受牛熊周期时点影响。

label.en: The whole fourth quarter (October to December)

claim.en: Natural gas rallies into winter: buy in autumn, sell in winter.
claim.zh: 天然气入冬上涨：秋天买，冬天卖。

whoSaysIt.en: Energy traders and commodity seasonality guides.
whoSaysIt.zh: 大宗商品季节性之一，“取暖季”行情。

howTested.en: Monthly returns of the natural gas ETF UNG. The trade buys at the end of August and sells at the end of December, so it earns the September to December monthly returns; these are compared with the other eight months (Welch t-stat). UNG holds futures and loses value as contracts are rolled, which affects every month.
howTested.zh: 天然气ETF（UNG）的月度收益。这笔交易8月底买入、12月底卖出，赚的是9月到12月四个月的收益，把它们与其余八个月比较（Welch t 值）。UNG持有期货，换月时有损耗，会拖累每一个月。

caveat.en: UNG has heavy roll-decay and structural losses; seasonality is overshadowed by contango.
caveat.zh: UNG展期损耗严重，季节性可能被期货升水吃掉。

short.en: Do not catch a falling knife

claim.en: Don't catch a falling knife: never buy something in a downtrend.
claim.zh: 不要接飞刀：下跌趋势中不要抄底。

whoSaysIt.en: Trader's proverb contradicting 'buy the dip'.
whoSaysIt.zh: “空仓等企稳”，股评常告诫别接下跌的飞刀。

howTested.en: Event: the close is down 10% or more over 20 trading days and is below its 200-day average. We record the 21-trading-day return from that close (events at least 21 days apart). The claim says buying here is a bad idea, so it holds only if the return is clearly lower than the market's average 21-day return. The same fall above the 200-day average is shown for contrast.
howTested.zh: 事件：收盘价20个交易日累计下跌10%以上，并且在200日均线下方。记录该收盘之后21个交易日的收益（事件间隔至少21天）。说法认为在这里买入不划算，所以只有收益明显低于该市场的21日平均收益，才算成立。200日均线上方的同样跌幅作对照。

caveat.en: It overlaps with 'buy the dip'; real traders also use position size.
caveat.zh: 与“抄底”结论互相印证，但实际交易还涉及仓位。

zh: 左侧交易 vs 右侧交易

label.en: 20-day fall of 10% or more, below the 200-day average
label.zh: 20日跌幅达10%以上，且在200日均线下方
同样的跌幅，但在200日均线上方

short.en: Correlations go to one in a crisis

claim.en: In a crisis all correlations go to 1, so diversification fails when you need it.
claim.zh: 危机时所有资产相关性趋向1，分散化失效。

whoSaysIt.en: Common refrain after 2008, 2020.
whoSaysIt.zh: “危机时无处可逃”，2008、2020以后常被提起。

howTested.en: For every pair of the ten markets we compute the correlation of daily returns on common dates, separately for days when SPY is more than 10% below its previous peak (stress, known at the previous close) and for all other days, then average over pairs. A rise of at least 0.15 in both halves of the history counts as correlations rising meaningfully in stress.
howTested.zh: 对十个市场里的每一对，在共同交易日上分别计算日收益相关系数：一组是SPY比前期高点低10%以上的日子（以前一天收盘判断的压力期），另一组是其余日子，再对所有配对取平均。压力期的平均相关系数至少升高0.15，并且前后两半历史都成立，才算相关性明显上升。

caveat.en: Crisis windows overlap, so the number of independent crises is only a few.
caveat.zh: 独立的危机事件只有几次。

en: correlations go to one in a crisis
zh: 股市暴跌所有资产一起跌

claim.en: The gold/silver ratio reverts: when it is high, silver is the buy.
claim.zh: 金银比会回归：金银比偏高时买白银。

whoSaysIt.en: Precious-metals dealers and Reddit r/Silverbugs.
whoSaysIt.zh: 贵金属圈的“金银比交易”，银价便宜时买入。

howTested.en: Ratio = GLD close divided by SLV close. Event: the log ratio is more than two standard deviations above its trailing 252-day mean. We record the change in the ratio over the next 63 trading days (events at least 63 days apart) and compare it with the average 63-day change. If the ratio reverts, it should fall by more than usual, which would make silver the better buy.
howTested.zh: 金银比 = GLD收盘价 / SLV收盘价。事件：金银比的对数高于其252日均值2个标准差以上。记录之后63个交易日金银比的变化（事件间隔至少63天），与平均的63日变化比较。如果金银比会回归，它应当比平常跌得更多，也就是白银更值得买。

caveat.en: Silver and gold ETF prices embed trends; ratios can persist for years.
caveat.zh: 金银比可以持续偏离很多年。

label.en: Gold/silver ratio more than 2 standard deviations above its 252-day average
label.zh: 金银比高于252日均值2个标准差以上

claim.en: Buy 20-day or 55-day breakouts, the turtle way.
claim.zh: 突破20日、55日高点就买，海龟法则。

whoSaysIt.en: Richard Dennis and Bill Eckhardt's Turtle experiment (1983).
whoSaysIt.zh: 海龟交易法则，在知乎和雪球上有大量复现。

howTested.en: Long from the day after the close exceeds the highest close of the previous 20 days; cash from the day after the close falls below the lowest close of the previous 10 days. The claim holds if the Sharpe ratio beats buy-and-hold in the full history and in both halves on most markets. The original Turtle system used intraday highs and lows, so this is a close-based approximation.
howTested.zh: 收盘价突破前20日最高收盘价的次日起持有；收盘价跌破前10日最低收盘价的次日起空仓。多数市场的夏普比率在全样本以及前后两半都超过买入持有，说法才成立。海龟原版用的是盘中高低点，这里是用收盘价近似。

caveat.en: Uses closes, not intraday highs/lows as the original system did.
caveat.zh: 海龟原版用盘中高低点，我们只有收盘价。

claim.en: After three down days in a row, the market bounces.
claim.zh: 连跌三天后必反弹。

whoSaysIt.en: Larry Connors's short-term mean reversion research.
whoSaysIt.zh: 短线交易圈的“连阴必反弹”。

howTested.en: Event: three consecutive daily closes lower than the previous close. We record the return over the next three trading days (events at least 3 days apart) and compare it with the market's average 3-day return. The same pattern above the 200-day average is shown for contrast.
howTested.zh: 事件：连续三个交易日收盘价都低于前一天。记录之后三个交易日的收益（事件间隔至少3天），与该市场的3日平均收益比较。200日均线上方的同样形态作对照。

caveat.en: Effect is small and sensitive to costs and regime.
caveat.zh: 效应很小，对成本和市场状态敏感。

en: 3 down days in a row stock market

label.en: Three down closes in a row
Three down closes, above the 200-day average
label.zh: 连续三天收跌，且在200日均线上方

claim.en: When the dollar falls, gold rises.
claim.zh: 美元走弱，黄金上涨。

whoSaysIt.en: Macro commentators.
whoSaysIt.zh: “美元和黄金负相关”，是金价评论的常用逻辑。

howTested.en: We use EUR/USD as an inverse dollar proxy (euro up means dollar down). Correlation of daily returns between EUR/USD and GLD on common dates, for the full history and each half. A positive correlation of at least 0.30 in all three periods counts as the dollar and gold moving oppositely; 0.10 to 0.30 as a weak link.
howTested.zh: 用欧元兑美元作美元的反向替代（欧元涨即美元跌）。计算欧元兑美元与GLD在共同交易日的日收益相关系数，看全样本和前后两半。三个时期的正相关都达到0.30以上，才算美元与黄金反向变动；0.10到0.30之间算联系较弱。

caveat.en: EUR/USD is only one of several currencies in the dollar index.
caveat.zh: 欧元兑美元只是美元指数的一部分。

label.en: Gold on days when EUR/USD rose 0.5% or more
label.zh: 欧元兑美元单日涨0.5%以上时的黄金

claim.en: Ethereum follows Bitcoin: when BTC moves, alts follow a few days later.
claim.zh: 比特币涨了，以太坊和山寨跟涨，有滞后。

whoSaysIt.en: Alt season narratives on YouTube.
whoSaysIt.zh: 币圈“BTC带动山寨”“山寨季”之说。

howTested.en: Correlation between Bitcoin's return on day t and Ether's return on day t+1, t+2 and t+3, on common dates. A real lag effect needs a correlation of at least 0.10 with a t-stat above 2.4 (slightly stricter than 2 because three lags are examined) and a positive sign in both halves.
howTested.zh: 比特币第t天的收益与以太坊第t+1、t+2、t+3天的收益之间的相关系数，用共同交易日。真正的滞后效应要求相关系数至少0.10、t 值高于2.4（看了三个滞后期，所以比2稍严），并且前后两半都为正。

caveat.en: Daily closes can't detect intraday lags; same-day correlation dominates.
caveat.zh: 日线看不出日内领先滞后。
